title: SURF AIR MOBILITY INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. entered into a $15 million promissory note agreement with LamVen on April 20, 2026. The note carries a 12.5% annual interest rate, a $1.5 million origination fee (payable in cash or stock at $1.274/share), and matures April 20, 2029. The borrowing is secured by aircraft assets including airframes, engines, and helicopters, with advances capped at $5 million per 90-day period.
key_points: Promissory note principal amount: up to $15 million with LamVen
Interest rate: 12.5% per annum, payable monthly in cash or stock at $1.274/share
Origination fee: $1.5 million due after July 19, 2026 or first Advance, payable in cash or company stock
Collateral: Aircraft assets (airframes, engines, propellers, helicopters) and related records
Advance limitations: Max $5 million per 90-day period commencing April 20, 2026
Maturity date: April 20, 2029; note is non-recourse to the Company
